0ydnysfw20t0c SELECT TO_CHAR(current_timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'GMT', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS TZD') AS curr_timestamp, SUM(failed_count) AS failed_count , TO_CHAR(MIN(first_occur_time), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS first_occur_time, TO_CHAR(MAX(last_occur_time), 'yyyy-mm-dd hh24:mi:ss') AS last_occur_time, name FROM (SELECT COUNT(db_user) AS failed_count, MIN(extended_timestamp) AS first_occur_time, MAX(extended_timestamp) AS last_occur_time, c.name FROM sys.cdb_common_audit_trail a, v$containers c WHERE a.action BETWEEN 100 AND 102 AND a.returncode != 0 AND a.STATEMENT_TYPE = 'LOGON' AND a.extended_timestamp >= current_timestamp - TO_DSINTERVAL('0 0:30:00') AND a.con_id = c.con_id GROUP BY c.name UNION SELECT COUNT(DBUSERNAME) AS failed_count, MIN(event_timestamp) AS first_occur_time, MAX(event_timestamp) AS last_occur_time, c.name FROM cdb_unified_audit_trail a, v$containers c WHERE a.ACTION_NAME='LOGON' and a.return_code <> 0 AND a.event_timestamp >= current_timestamp - TO_DSINTERVAL('0 0:30:00') AND a.con_id = c.con_id GROUP BY c.name ) GROUP BY name

Finding 7: Hard Parse Due to Sharing Criteria
Impact is .32 active sessions, 2.72% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
SQL statements with the same text were not shared because of cursor
environment mismatch. This resulted in additional hard parses which were
consuming significant database time.
Common causes of environment mismatch are session NLS settings, SQL trace
settings and optimizer parameters.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .32 active sessions, 2.72% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
   Action
      Look for top reason for cursor environment mismatch in
      V$SQL_SHARED_CURSOR.

   Symptoms That Led to the Finding:
   ---------------------------------
      Hard parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.
      Impact is 2.29 active sessions, 19.19% of total activity.

Impact is .26 active sessions, 2.21% of total activity.
-------------------------------------------------------
Soft parsing of SQL statements was consuming significant database time.

   Recommendation 1: Application Analysis
   Estimated benefit is .26 active sessions, 2.21% of total activity.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------
